profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at ServiceNow
profile.summary:
Staff Software Engineer interested in team performance, growing young engineers and fostering team well-being in the workplace.

Mindfulness Meditation Certified  Teacher trained for 2 years by world re-known meditation teachers such as Tara Brach (Phd), Jack Kornfield (Phd) or Ekhart Tolle.

I also facilitate in-house Mindfulness Based Emotional Intelligence trainings using Mindfulness and relying on the latest research in Neuroscience. 

Received the 5 Mindfulness Trainings by Zen Master Thich Nhat Hanh.

positions.description: Rebuilding TurboTax with NodeJS, building web apps with expressJS and reactJS.

positions.title: Technical Development Supervisor
positions.description:
- Act as a technical leader for internal teams including managing code reviews, post project analysis and clearly articulating throughout the duration of projects what is important to the project's success, the priority of requirements and other key messages. 
- Manage multiple applications/development projects across the sub-teams that comprise this group.
- Coordinate status and communication within the organization and to interested partners/peer teams within the organization. 
- Act independently to determine approach and process for project assignments. 
- Act as technical lead for agile based scrum teams and provides technical direction as it relates to process development and Java based technology research, prototyping and implementation. 
- Create an environment where people are encouraged to share information, constructively debate, and communicate freely. 
- Work with multiple teams to improve product definition, deployment, software quality, and assess resource availability in relation to timelines. 
- Work with the business to analyze business requirements as well as lead the development team.

Technology stack:
HTML5, jQuery, BackboneJS, CoffeeScript, Grails, Groovy, Geb (automation testing), Spock, Jenkins, Git/Github, REST.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
- Build and maintain web applications that support Sony's PlayStation Network. 
- Provide web development and software engineering expertise within a group of web developers.  
- Provide mentoring, training and develop ongoing education programs to assist in the growth of other team member skills. 
- Work closely with the Web Development Lead and Project Managers to ensure best use of team resources and identify areas where team performance can be improved. 
- Develop and maintain, as a part of the team, all of the company's current and upcoming web application UI tiers. 

Supervised and lead the development of 2 projects implemented by 2 teams: 1 local team and 1 outsourced team.
Role: 
- Establish application architecture, coding practices, software process (behavior driven development, code review, agile development) 
- Assist and mentor team members
- Review and implement features
- Research best practices and tools

Technology stack:
HTML5, jQuery, BackboneJS, CoffeeScript, Grails, Groovy, Geb (automation testing), Spock, Jenkins, Git/Github, REST.

Performed presentations on the following topics:
- JavaScript scalability and maintainability
- CSS scalability and maintainability (Sass, CSS grids)
- JavaScript testing (Jasmine)
- Front-end performance
- RESTful design
- BackboneJS
- CoffeeScript
- Groovy
- Functional automation testing (Geb/Spock)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Software Engineer for the Internet System Group

- Lead the front-end web development for the company's web projects (extranet, brands and social networking websites): developed JavaScript objects libraries, jQuery plugins, JavaScript unit tests and CSS layout and design to implement innovative features and services. 

- Responsible for development, testing, deployment and maintenance of 10+ brand and corporate ASP.NET websites powered by Ektron Content Management System

- Performed multiple presentations to the team to promote the use of technologies such as CSS, ASP.NET MVC, jQuery, Silverlight or Ruby on Rails to improve the team's productivity and skills.

- Provided requirements analysis, solution design, work effort estimates and deployment coordination for multiple web applications.

- Implemented class libraries using NHibernate, Log4Net, NUnit

Technology stack: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, C#, ASP.NET, MS SQL
